description: This file implements the main logic for trigger handling, fuel injection control, and ignition scheduling in an engine management firmware. It includes trigger callbacks, fuel injection timing, and prime injection pulses, with references to external hardware and configuration parameters.

methods.name: startSimultaniousInjection
methods.description: Activates all injectors simultaneously by setting their pins high.

methods.name: endSimultaniousInjectionOnlyTogglePins
methods.description: Deactivates all injectors by setting their pins low.

methods.name: endSimultaniousInjection
methods.description: Ends simultaneous injection and schedules fuel events for the corresponding cylinder.

methods.name: tempTurnPinHigh
methods.description: Sets a specific injector output pin high, managing overlapping injection logic.

methods.name: seTurnPinHigh
methods.description: Sets multiple output pins high for a given injection pair.

methods.name: tempTurnPinLow
methods.description: Turns a specific injector output pin low, handling overlapping injection logic.

methods.name: seTurnPinLow
methods.description: Turns off all output pins for a given injection pair and schedules the deactivation.

methods.name: sescheduleByTimestamp
methods.description: Schedules a callback function to run at a specific timestamp in the future.

methods.name: handleFuelInjectionEvent
methods.description: Handles scheduling and control of fuel injection events based on engine RPM and injection duration.

methods.name: fuelClosedLoopCorrection
methods.description: Adjusts fuel mixture correction using PID control based on sensor readings and engine state.

methods.name: handleFuel
methods.description: Main method for managing injection timing and scheduling for each injection event.

methods.name: showMainHistogram
methods.description: Displays the main callback histogram for diagnostic purposes.

methods.name: mainTriggerCallback
methods.description: Main interrupt handler for trigger events, managing ignition and fuel injection scheduling based on trigger input and engine RPM.

methods.name: isPrimeInjectionPulseSkipped
methods.description: Determines if a prime injection pulse should be skipped based on engine state.

methods.name: startPrimeInjectionPulse
methods.description: Initiates a prime injection pulse at engine startup or specific conditions, scheduling injection and turn-off timing.

methods.name: updatePrimeInjectionPulseState
methods.description: Updates the prime injection pulse state, resetting counters when engine starts.

methods.name: showTriggerHistogram
methods.description: Displays histograms related to trigger processing for diagnostics.

methods.name: showMainInfo
methods.description: Outputs main engine parameters such as RPM and load for diagnostics.

methods.name: initMainEventListener
methods.description: Initializes event listeners, including trigger callback registration and diagnostic setup.
